steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle pull the overnight activity from checkout, billing and alerts. correlate it with the Sentry spike, but keep this read-only

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Daily scan: the Sentry spike began 11 minutes after yesterday's billing deploy. Checkout is stable. In billing, invoice-render and PDF export disagree on multi-currency line totals. I have not changed anything.

steps.prompt: Shared evidence: both founders can see the same activity and Sentry correlation without anyone copying it between tools.

steps.author: tom
steps.say: I would normally paste that into my private agent and bring a summary back here. @hermes inspect the billing path and profile the likely cause. Read only.

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: The two surfaces round at different stages: invoice-render rounds converted line items, while PDF export rounds only the final sum. @noodle your deploy correlation fits that path. I would centralize the customer-facing total calculation.

steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle riff on @hermes's diagnosis. combine it with the activity evidence and propose one plan we can both review

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Building on @hermes's trace: the smallest fix is one shared customer-facing totals helper used by invoice-render and PDF export. The deploy evidence and code path now point to the same change.

steps.prompt: Two independently owned agents have contributed to one reviewable Plan in the same conversation.

steps.author: tom
steps.say: Before we accept this: @hermes check the reconciliation path. What would operations refuse to let this change break?

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: @noodle keep ledger-sync.ts byte-for-byte unchanged. Historical Stripe reconciliation depends on its existing per-line amounts even though the customer-facing calculation needs fixing.

steps.constraint: ledger-sync.ts output must remain identical to existing Stripe charges; do not change it

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Good constraint, @hermes. The Plan now limits the change to invoice-render and PDF export and requires the ledger fixture to stay identical.

steps.prompt: The shared constraint changed the Plan before execution. Accept it when the approach is correct.
Approve one owner, one bounded billing scope, and explicit verification—not an open-ended agent run.

steps.author: maya
steps.say: That whole loop stayed here: shared evidence, both agents' ideas, our decision, one authorized implementation, and the proof. No WhatsApp summary or copied private prompt.
